risks.risk: Rear disc brake may not be functional or may not be present (only front confirmed visually).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear wheel hub/rotor and a short video of spinning the rear wheel while braking (showing rotor + caliper).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully confirmed dual disc (worst case: single disc or rear brake not working).

risks.risk: Suspension condition (leaks, seized movement, bent linkage) cannot be assessed from one photo.
risks.proof: Video compressing front fork and rear shock (showing smooth rebound) plus close-up photos of fork seals and rear shock body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as suspension may need service (worst case: not smooth/needs repair).

risks.risk: Frame size and wheel size (affects value) are not readable from the photo.
risks.proof: Photo showing the frame size marking (if any) and a measurement/label of wheel size (e.g., 26/27.5/29) or a clear shot of the tire sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a generic mid-range value for an unknown size.

risks.risk: Drivetrain wear (chain stretch, worn sprockets/cassette, slipping gears) cannot be confirmed remotely.
risks.proof: Video riding/gear shifting through all gears + close-up of chain and rear sprockets for wear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drivetrain may be worn (worst case: needs chain/sprocket service).

risks.risk: Brake performance and tire condition (tread depth, sidewall cracks) not verifiable from this single image.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls + video hard braking on a safe surface.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires/brakes may need replacement or service.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the rear disc rotor + caliper (and front rotor too) to confirm true dual disc.
Short video compressing the front fork and rear shock to show smooth movement and rebound.
Photos of the drivetrain: shifters, chain, and rear sprocket cluster (plus a gear-shifting video).
Tire sidewall close-ups showing wheel size and brand/model (and tread condition).
Any frame markings/serial/brand plate close-up to confirm 'shockwave sport' claim.
response.reason: The photo supports dual suspension and a geared setup, but key value drivers (confirmed dual disc, suspension health, wheel size/frame size, and drivetrain/brake condition) are not provable from the single image, so a reliable worst-case price needs the missing proof.
